cases.purpose: Multiple PID query order and accumulated errors, with failure in each position
cases.oracle: Explicit query-format requirement: query all PIDs in order and retain failure status; independently configured owned children have distinct priorities.
cases.comparison: Exact stdout and status, with ESRCH diagnostic normalized.
cases.script:
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
/usr/bin/python3 worker.py one 2 3 & first=$!
/usr/bin/python3 worker.py two 3 0 & last=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$first" "$last" 2>/dev/null; wait "$first" "$last" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
/usr/bin/python3 ready.py one two || exit 90
/usr/bin/true & dead=$!; wait "$dead"
for position in middle first last; do
  case $position in
    middle) ionice -p "$first" -p "$dead" -p "$last" > out 2> err; rc=$? ;;
    first)  ionice -p "$dead" -p "$first" -p "$last" > out 2> err; rc=$? ;;
    last)   ionice -p "$first" -p "$last" -p "$dead" > out 2> err; rc=$? ;;
  esac
  printf '%s:\n' "$position"
  /usr/bin/cat out
  diagnostic=$(<err)
  [[ $diagnostic == *"No such process"* ]] && d=ESRCH || d=other
  printf 'status=%s diagnostic=%s\n' "$rc" "$d"
done
rm -f out err
cases.stdout:
middle:
best-effort: prio 3
idle
status=1 diagnostic=ESRCH
first:
best-effort: prio 3
idle
status=1 diagnostic=ESRCH
last:
best-effort: prio 3
idle
status=1 diagnostic=ESRCH

files.worker.py:
import pathlib,signal,sys
import ioprio
label=sys.argv[1];ioprio.set(0,int(sys.argv[2]),int(sys.argv[3]))
pathlib.Path('ready-'+label).write_text('ready\n')
signal.alarm(15)
while True:signal.pause()
